description: Find the brands (makers) of cannabis-based medicines listed on Findabis, by name or by the dose forms they make. Returns up to 25 brands at a time (page on with `offset`) with slug, page URL, town and country, website, and how many of their products Findabis lists — a count, never stock or which pharmacies hold them. Sorted by name or by product count, never by sponsorship. A listing is not an endorsement. For one brand in full, use get_listing with kind "brand"; for its products, find_products with the brand name as `query`.

category.description: Only brands with a listed product in this dose form. CARTRIDGE is a vape cartridge.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for the next page (the answer says which offset comes next). Default 0.

query.description: Brand name, matched as text. Omit to browse.

sort.description: name_asc (default), name_desc, or products_desc (most listed products first).

name: find_brands

productCount.description: Products of this brand listed on Findabis (approved and not withdrawn); a count, never stock

url.description: Canonical Findabis page, absolute; null when the listing has no page

total.description: How many matched in all; narrow the query when this exceeds the results

title: Find medical cannabis brands
